tools.name: hemelion_assess_decision_readiness
tools.description: Use this when a person has a non-regulated decision and wants to know whether to protect the downside, run a bounded test, or close the evidence window. Uses four 1–5 ratings and returns a transparent rule. Do not use for emergencies or professional legal, medical, or financial advice.

tools.name: hemelion_get_method_and_evidence
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what Hemelion measures, how it differs from a generic AI chat, what it can and cannot claim, or whether its research is published.
